claimedSlice: opencv2/videostab/*.hpp parser-backed VideoStab public component-header closure; the umbrella has no parser declarations and protected implementation hooks are explicitly excluded
limitation: The map records parser identities and exact VideoStab wrapper evidence; it does not claim repository-wide contrib parity or external module availability.
externalDataDependencies: Video stabilization consumes caller-selected frame sequences or sources and carries callback, state, and Mat ownership contracts; the package has no native/managed VideoStab wrapper. Upstream VideoIO and CUDA components are optional build-time integrations, not runtime support claims for this package.
